    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND cost > 0 AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
net_cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Redemption', 'Withdrawal') THEN amount
                    WHEN type IN ('SIP', 'Lump Sum', 'Deposit') THEN -amount
                    ELSE 0 END) AS net_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario_shift AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_shift
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
components AS (
    SELECT h.investor_id,
           COALESCE(h.total_gain, 0) AS total_gain,
           COALESCE(c.net_flow, 0) AS net_flow,
           COALESCE(s.total_shift, 0) AS total_shift
    FROM valid_holdings h
    INNER JOIN net_cash_flow c ON h.investor_id = c.investor_id
    INNER JOIN scenario_shift s ON h.investor_id = s.investor_id
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           (total_gain - MIN(total_gain) OVER ()) / 
           (MAX(total_gain) OVER () - MIN(total_gain) OVER ()) AS norm_gain,
           (net_flow - MIN(net_flow) OVER ()) / 
           (MAX(net_flow) OVER () - MIN(net_flow) OVER ()) AS norm_flow,
           (total_shift - MIN(total_shift) OVER ()) / 
           (MAX(total_shift) OVER () - MIN(total_shift) OVER ()) AS norm_shift
    FROM components
),
composite_scores AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           ROUND(100 * (norm_gain + norm_flow + norm_shift) / 3, 2) AS composite_score
    FROM normalized
)
SELECT investor_id, composite_score
FROM composite_scores
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id
LIMIT 10;

        SUM(CASE WHEN cf.type IN ('Redemption', 'Withdrawal') THEN cf.amount ELSE -cf.amount END) AS net_cash_flow,
        SUM(sa.total_investment) AS total_sector_investment,
        SUM(ABS(sr.new_allocation_pct - sr.current_allocation_pct)) AS total_scenario_allocation_shift,
        ph.risk_score
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 cf
    JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 sa ON cf.investor_id = sa.investor_id
    JOIN ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 sr ON cf.investor_id = sr.investor_id
    JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 ph ON cf.investor_id = ph.investor_id
    GROUP BY cf.investor_id
    HAVING 
        net_cash_flow IS NOT NULL 
        AND total_sector_investment IS NOT NULL 
        AND total_scenario_allocation_shift IS NOT NULL 
        AND risk_score IS NOT NULL

normalized_components AS (
    SELECT

        (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) / (MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) AS norm_net_cash_flow,

ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id

WITH component_data AS (
    SELECT 
        p.investor_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cf.type IN ('Redemption', 'Withdrawal') THEN cf.amount ELSE -cf.amount END), 0) AS net_cash_flow,
        COALESCE(SUM(ra.amount), 0) AS total_rebalance_amount,
        COALESCE(SUM(sr.new_allocation_pct - sr.current_allocation_pct), 0) AS total_scenario_shift,
        COALESCE(AVG(g.shortfall), 0) AS avg_goal_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    LEFT JOIN ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 cf ON p.investor_id = cf.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 ra ON p.investor_id = ra.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 sr ON p.investor_id = sr.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 g ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id
    GROUP BY p.investor_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cf.investor_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ra.investor_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.investor_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.investor_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0
),
normalized_components AS (
    SELECT 
        investor_id,
        net_cash_flow,
        total_rebalance_amount,
        total_scenario_shift,
        avg_goal_shortfall,
        (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER (), 0) AS norm_cash_flow,
        (total_rebalance_amount - MIN(total_rebalance_amount) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(total_rebalance_amount) OVER () - MIN(total_rebalance_amount) OVER (), 0) AS norm_rebalance,
        (total_scenario_shift - MIN(total_scenario_shift) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(total_scenario_shift) OVER () - MIN(total_scenario_shift) OVER (), 0) AS norm_shift,
        1 - ((avg_goal_shortfall - MIN(avg_goal_shortfall) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(avg_goal_shortfall) OVER () - MIN(avg_goal_shortfall) OVER (), 0)) AS norm_shortfall
    FROM component_data
),
composite_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        investor_id,
        net_cash_flow,
        total_rebalance_amount,
        total_scenario_shift,
        avg_goal_shortfall,
        100 * (norm_cash_flow + norm_rebalance + norm_shift + norm_shortfall) / 4 AS composite_score
    FROM normalized_components
)
SELECT 
    investor_id,
    ROUND(composite_score, 2) AS composite_score,
    net_cash_flow,
    total_rebalance_amount,
    total_scenario_shift,
    ROUND(avg_goal_shortfall, 2) AS avg_goal_shortfall
FROM composite_scores
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id
LIMIT 10;
